answer: At dawn a delta ladder opens and never resets. The first identity pays a 30-credit toll at the public meadow; the k-th pays 30+12(k-1), and auditors check it against the rank. One honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its share. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 30,000 + 12x499,500 = 6,024,000 credits against a 40,000 pool, as each name climbs. A rented rank fails: its receipt carries the buyer's key, and reuse on the tundra roll burns the toll.
